allow_open_registration.description: If true, users may create rooms without requiring pre-registration or admin approval.

allowed_domains.description: List of XMPP domains whose users may create rooms. Empty = allow all.

disabled_features.description: List of MUC features to disable (e.g., 'muc_public', 'muc_passwordprotected'). See XEP-0045 for feature names.

jid.description: Jabber ID (JID) of the MUC component; must be unique within the XMPP domain.

log.description: Path to log file. Use 'stdout' or 'stderr' for console logging.

log_level.description: Minimum log level; options: debug, info, warn, error, critical.

max_occupants.description: Default maximum number of users allowed per MUC room.

min_password_length.description: Minimum length required for passwords on password-protected rooms.

namespace_prefix.description: XMPP namespace prefix for room JIDs (e.g., 'muc' → rooms at 'room@muc.example.com').

room_presets.description: List of named room presets to configure different room behavior profiles.

announcement_services.description: List of service JIDs allowed to send announcements to rooms using this preset.

max_occupants.description: Override for max occupants per room of this preset type (uses global default if omitted).

persistent.description: If true, rooms created with this preset are stored persistently (survive restarts).

secret.description: Secret shared secret used to authenticate this component to the Jabber server. Must be strong and kept confidential.

ssl.description: SSL/TLS settings for component-to-server communication (if using encrypted XMPP component protocol).

ca_cert.description: Optional path to CA certificate bundle for verifying server certificate.

key.description: Path to SSL private key file.
